description: Iowa 4.0 Work Zone Data Exchange Feed Example is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation. This dataset provides archived lane closure occurrences within the Iowa Department of Transportation (IDOT) highway system in a tabular format. The ITS JPO has collections from 23 states including Iowa covering various parts of the time period from 10/2019 to 08/2024 depending on when the feed was active. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 17 columns, among them start_date_accuracy, restrictions, lanes, ending_accuracy, end_date_accuracy, core_details. The portal shows 2026-03-23 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
